# 2. Modelo Lineal Mixto Generalizado (GLMM)

## 2.1 Formulación

De acuerdo con la literatura pediátrica, el desarrollo infantil durante
el primer año de vida presenta un comportamiento de crecimiento
exponencial rápido. Se implementó un GLMM con función de enlace
logarítmico y distribución Gamma.

Sea $Y_{ij}$ el índice de crecimiento observado para el paciente $i$ en
el tiempo $j$:

$$Y_{ij} | u_i \sim \text{Gamma}(\mu_{ij},\nu)$$

$$\log(\mu_{ij}) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \text{Parto}_i + \beta_2 \text{Tiempo}_j + u_i$$

$$u_i \sim N(0, \sigma^2_u)$$

**Parámetros:**

- $\beta_0$: Intercepto fijo.
- $\beta_1$: Efecto fijo del tipo de nacimiento (Cesárea vs. Vaginal).
- $\beta_2$: Efecto fijo de la etapa de medición (I, II, III).
- $u_i$: Efecto aleatorio (intercepto) específico para el paciente $i$.

## 2.2 Ajuste del modelo

```{r glmm_fit, include=FALSE}
df$p_code = as.factor(df$p_code)
df$b_type = as.factor(df$b_type)

df = df %>%
  mutate(
    t_time = case_when(
      samp_n == 1 ~ "I",
      samp_n == 2 ~ "II",
      samp_n == 3 ~ "III"
    )
  )
df$t_time = factor(df$t_time, levels = c("I", "II", "III"))

mod1_glmm = glmer(
  g_index ~ t_time + b_type + (1 | p_code),
  data = df,
  family = Gamma(link = "log")
)
```

## 2.3 Resultados

Los resultados del análisis de devianza confirmaron que el tiempo de
medición tiene un efecto principal altamente significativo sobre el
índice de crecimiento ($\chi^2 = 518.73$, $p < 0.001$). El tipo de
nacimiento no mostró un impacto estadísticamente significativo
($p = 0.760$).

```{r glmm_anova, include=FALSE}
anova_glmm = car::Anova(mod1_glmm)
```

```{r}
anova_glmm
```

## 2.4 Estimaciones marginales

```{r glmm_emmeans, include=FALSE}
emmeans_res = emmeans(mod1_glmm, pairwise ~ t_time, type = "response")
```

```{r}
emmeans_res
```

Al evaluar las estimaciones marginales, se evidenció un incremento
progresivo del índice promedio: 9.23 (T1) -> 11.15 (T2) -> 12.19 (T3).
El crecimiento es estadísticamente significativo en cada transición
temporal ($p < 0.001$).

# 3. Clustering PAM (Bray-Curtis)

## 3.1 Preparación de datos

Se calcula la abundancia relativa y se organizan los datos por tipo de
muestra y tiempo:

```{r prep_clustering, include=FALSE}
ps_relative = transform_sample_counts(HMilkclean_filtered, function(x) x / sum(x))

df_ps = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_relative))
taxa_info = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_relative))

taxa_genus = taxa_info$Genus
taxa_genus[is.na(taxa_genus)] = "unclassified"
row.names(df_ps) = make.unique(as.character(taxa_genus))

asv_df_T = as.data.frame(t(df_ps))
asv_df_T[] = lapply(asv_df_T, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

asv_df_genus = asv_df_T %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "sam_id") %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type = case_when(
      startsWith(sam_id, "MH") ~ "Stool",
      startsWith(sam_id, "ML") ~ "Milk",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    time = case_when(
      endsWith(sam_id, "-I")   ~ "I",
      endsWith(sam_id, "-II")  ~ "II",
      endsWith(sam_id, "-III") ~ "III"
    ),
    time = factor(time, levels = c("I", "II", "III"))
  )

cluster_by_time_type = split(
  asv_df_genus,
  f = list(asv_df_genus$sample_type, asv_df_genus$time),
  sep = "_"
)
cluster_by_time_type = cluster_by_time_type[sapply(cluster_by_time_type, nrow) > 0]
type_of_cluster_to_graph = names(cluster_by_time_type)
```

## 3.2 Fórmulas

La abundancia relativa del taxón $j$ en la muestra $i$:

$$x'_{ij} = \frac{x_{ij}}{\sum_{j} x_{ij}}$$

La disimilitud de Bray-Curtis entre muestras $i$ y $k$ (con valores
estandarizados que suman 1):

$$BC_{ik} = \frac{\sum_{j} |x'_{ij} - x'_{kj}|}{2}$$

## 3.3 Índice de silueta (k = 2–10)

```{r pam_silhouette, include=FALSE}
silhouette_plots = list()

for (group_name in type_of_cluster_to_graph) {
  current_df = cluster_by_time_type[[group_name]]
  asv_numeric = current_df %>% select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time)
  
  asv_numeric[] = lapply(asv_numeric, as.numeric)
  asv_numeric[is.na(asv_numeric)] = 0
  asv_numeric = asv_numeric[rowSums(asv_numeric) > 0, ]
  asv_numeric = asv_numeric[, colSums(asv_numeric) > 0]
  
  if (nrow(asv_numeric) < 4) next
  
  bray_dist_matrix = vegdist(asv_numeric, method = "bray")
  
  silhouette_scores = rep(NA, 10)
  for (k in 2:10) {
    if (k >= nrow(asv_numeric)) break
    pam_result = pam(bray_dist_matrix, k = k)
    silhouette_scores[k] = pam_result$silinfo$avg.width
  }
  
  plot_data = data.frame(k = 2:10, score = silhouette_scores[2:10])
  plot_data = plot_data[!is.na(plot_data$score), ]
  
  silhouette_plots[[group_name]] =
    ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = k, y = score)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.70, linetype = "dashed", color = "#4CAF50", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.50, linetype = "dashed", color = "#FF9800", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "#F44336", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_line(color = "#0073C2", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(color = "#0073C2", size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = 10, y = 0.85, label = "Strong (Very Good)", color = "#4CAF50", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 10, y = 0.60, label = "Reasonable (Good)", color = "#FF9800", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 10, y = 0.37, label = "Weak (Regular)", color = "#F44336", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
      annotate("text", x = 10, y = 0.12, label = "Without Structure (Deficient)", color = "grey50", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Average Silhouette Score -", group_name),
        x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
        y = "Average Silhouette Score"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(2, 10), breaks = 2:10) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

Los valores de silueta se mantienen por debajo del umbral de 0.50 para
todos los $k$ evaluados, y en la mayoría de los puntos no superan 0.25.
**No hay estructura de agrupamiento conformada.**

**Figura 1:** *Índice de silueta en leche materna (T1, T2, T3)*

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
#| label: fig-sil-leche
#| fig-cap: "Evaluación de la estructura de agrupamiento por índice de silueta en la leche materna."

(silhouette_plots[['Milk_I']] / silhouette_plots[['Milk_II']] / silhouette_plots[['Milk_III']])
```

**Figura 2:** *Índice de silueta en heces del infante (T1, T2, T3)*

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=12}
#| label: fig-sil-heces
#| fig-cap: "Evaluación de la estructura de agrupamiento por índice de silueta en heces del infante."

(silhouette_plots[['Stool_I']] / silhouette_plots[['Stool_II']] / silhouette_plots[['Stool_III']])
```

# 4. Transformación CLR y Clustering

## 4.1 Imputación de ceros y transformación CLR

```{r clr_process, include=FALSE}
imputar_ceros_bayes = function(physeq_obj) {
  otu_mat = as(otu_table(physeq_obj), "matrix")
  if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_obj)) otu_mat = t(otu_mat)
  
  otu_imputed = cmultRepl(otu_mat, method = "CZM", label = 0,
                          output = "p-counts", suppress.print = TRUE)
  
  if (taxa_are_rows(physeq_obj)) otu_imputed = t(otu_imputed)
  
  otu_table(physeq_obj) = otu_table(otu_imputed, taxa_are_rows = taxa_are_rows(physeq_obj))
  return(physeq_obj)
}

process_to_clr = function(physeq_subset, tipo_muestra, prev_threshold = 0.10) {
  physeq_glom = tax_glom(physeq_subset, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
  physeq_limpio = filter_taxa(physeq_glom, function(x) sum(x > 0) > (prev_threshold * length(x)), TRUE)
  physeq_imp = imputar_ceros_bayes(physeq_limpio)
  physeq_clr = microbiome::transform(physeq_imp, "clr")
  
  df_clr = as.data.frame(otu_table(physeq_clr))
  taxa_info = as.data.frame(tax_table(physeq_clr))
  
  taxa_genus = taxa_info$Genus
  taxa_genus[is.na(taxa_genus)] = "unclassified"
  row.names(df_clr) = make.unique(as.character(taxa_genus))
  
  asv_df_T = as.data.frame(t(df_clr))
  asv_df_T[] = lapply(asv_df_T, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))
  
  asv_df_T %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "sam_id") %>%
    mutate(
      sample_type = tipo_muestra,
      time = case_when(
        endsWith(sam_id, "-I")   ~ "I",
        endsWith(sam_id, "-II")  ~ "II",
        endsWith(sam_id, "-III") ~ "III",
        TRUE ~ "Unknown"
      ),
      time = factor(time, levels = c("I", "II", "III"))
    )
}

ps_milk  = subset_samples(HMilkclean_filtered, type == "Milk")
ps_stool = subset_samples(HMilkclean_filtered, type == "Stool")

df_milk_clr  = process_to_clr(ps_milk, "Milk")
df_stool_clr = process_to_clr(ps_stool, "Stool")

cluster_by_time_type_clr = c(
  split(df_milk_clr, df_milk_clr$time),
  split(df_stool_clr, df_stool_clr$time)
)
names(cluster_by_time_type_clr) = c(
  paste0("Milk_", names(split(df_milk_clr, df_milk_clr$time))),
  paste0("Stool_", names(split(df_stool_clr, df_stool_clr$time)))
)
cluster_by_time_type_clr = cluster_by_time_type_clr[sapply(cluster_by_time_type_clr, nrow) > 0]
type_of_cluster_to_graph_clr = names(cluster_by_time_type_clr)
```

## 4.2 Índice de silueta (distancia euclidiana en espacio CLR)

```{r clr_silhouette, include=FALSE}
silhouette_plots_clr = list()

for (group_name in type_of_cluster_to_graph_clr) {
  current_df_clr = cluster_by_time_type_clr[[group_name]]
  asv_numeric_clr = current_df_clr[sapply(current_df_clr, is.numeric)]
  asv_numeric_clr[] = lapply(asv_numeric_clr, as.numeric)
  asv_numeric_clr = asv_numeric_clr[, apply(asv_numeric_clr, 2, var) > 0]
  
  if (nrow(asv_numeric_clr) < 4) next
  
  aitchison_dist_matrix = dist(asv_numeric_clr, method = "euclidean")
  
  silhouette_scores = rep(NA, 10)
  for (k in 2:10) {
    if (k >= nrow(asv_numeric_clr)) break
    pam_result = pam(aitchison_dist_matrix, k = k)
    silhouette_scores[k] = pam_result$silinfo$avg.width
  }
  
  plot_data = data.frame(k = 2:10, score = silhouette_scores[2:10])
  plot_data = plot_data[!is.na(plot_data$score), ]
  
  silhouette_plots_clr[[group_name]] = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = k, y = score)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.70, linetype = "dashed", color = "#4CAF50", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.50, linetype = "dashed", color = "#FF9800", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "#F44336", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_line(color = "#0073C2", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(color = "#0073C2", size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = max(plot_data$k), y = 0.85, label = "Strong (Very Good)", color = "#4CAF50", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
    annotate("text", x = max(plot_data$k), y = 0.60, label = "Reasonable (Good)", color = "#FF9800", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
    annotate("text", x = max(plot_data$k), y = 0.37, label = "Weak (Regular)", color = "#F44336", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
    annotate("text", x = max(plot_data$k), y = 0.12, label = "Without Structure (Deficient)", color = "grey50", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Average Silhouette Score (CLR) -", group_name),
      x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
      y = "Average Silhouette Score"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:10) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

Los datos tienden a decaer en rendimiento en el promedio de silueta,
tanto en heces como en leches. No se observan grupos reales.

# 5. Maldición de las Altas Dimensiones

## 5.1 Robust PCA (Principal Component Pursuit)

```{r rpca, include=FALSE}
cluster_by_time_type_clr_Pursuit = list()

for (group_name in names(cluster_by_time_type_clr)) {
  current_df = cluster_by_time_type_clr[[group_name]]
  metadata_P = current_df %>% dplyr::select(sample_type, time, sam_id)
  asv_numeric = current_df %>% dplyr::select(-sample_type, -time, -sam_id)
  asv_numeric[] = lapply(asv_numeric, as.numeric)
  asv_numeric = asv_numeric[, apply(asv_numeric, 2, var) > 0]
  
  M = as.matrix(asv_numeric)
  rpca_result = rpca(M, max.iter = 10000)
  
  L_matrix = rpca_result$L
  L_df = as.data.frame(L_matrix)
  colnames(L_df) = colnames(asv_numeric)
  
  cluster_by_time_type_clr_Pursuit[[group_name]] = cbind(metadata_P, L_df)
}

silhouette_plots_Pursuit = list()

for (group_name in type_of_cluster_to_graph_clr) {
  current_df = cluster_by_time_type_clr_Pursuit[[group_name]]
  current_df = current_df %>% dplyr::select(-any_of(c("sample_type", "time", "sam_id")))
  
  asv_numeric = current_df[sapply(current_df, is.numeric)]
  asv_numeric[] = lapply(asv_numeric, as.numeric)
  asv_numeric = asv_numeric[, apply(asv_numeric, 2, var) > 0]
  
  if (nrow(asv_numeric) < 4) next
  
  aitchison_dist_matrix = vegdist(asv_numeric, method = "euclidean")
  
  silhouette_scores = rep(NA, 10)
  for (k in 2:10) {
    if (k >= nrow(asv_numeric)) break
    pam_result = pam(aitchison_dist_matrix, k = k)
    silhouette_scores[k] = pam_result$silinfo$avg.width
  }
  
  plot_data = data.frame(k = 2:10, score = silhouette_scores[2:10])
  plot_data = plot_data[!is.na(plot_data$score), ]
  
  silhouette_plots_Pursuit[[group_name]] = ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = k, y = score)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.70, linetype = "dashed", color = "#4CAF50", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.50, linetype = "dashed", color = "#FF9800", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed", color = "#F44336", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_line(color = "#0073C2", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(color = "#0073C2", size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Average Silhouette Score (RPCA L-Matrix) -", group_name),
      x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
      y = "Average Silhouette Score"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2:10) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
}
```

## 5.2 Sparse Hierarchical Clustering (Lasso)

Análisis especializado en **Heces**, el grupo más complejo de encontrar
estructura. Se aplica penalización L1 para seleccionar variables:

```{r sparse_hc, include=FALSE}
# Stool I
ST1 = cluster_by_time_type_clr[["Stool_I"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time) %>% as.matrix()

set.seed(123)
perm_out1 = HierarchicalSparseCluster.permute(
  x = ST1, wbounds = seq(1.5, 5, len = 10), nperms = 5
)
sparse_hc1 = HierarchicalSparseCluster(x = ST1, wbound = perm_out1$bestw)
nombres_clave1 = colnames(ST1)[sparse_hc1$ws > 0]

# Stool II
ST2 = cluster_by_time_type_clr[["Stool_II"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time) %>% as.matrix()

set.seed(123)
perm_out2 = HierarchicalSparseCluster.permute(
  x = ST2, wbounds = seq(1.5, 5, len = 10), nperms = 5
)
sparse_hc2 = HierarchicalSparseCluster(x = ST2, wbound = perm_out2$bestw)
nombres_clave2 = colnames(ST2)[sparse_hc2$ws > 0]

# Stool III
ST3 = cluster_by_time_type_clr[["Stool_III"]] %>%
  dplyr::select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time) %>% as.matrix()

set.seed(123)
perm_out3 = HierarchicalSparseCluster.permute(
  x = ST3, wbounds = seq(1.5, 5, len = 10), nperms = 5
)
sparse_hc3 = HierarchicalSparseCluster(x = ST3, wbound = perm_out3$bestw)
nombres_clave3 = colnames(ST3)[sparse_hc3$ws > 0]
```

### Bacterias discriminantes (Stool-I)

De los `r ncol(ST1)` ASVs iniciales, el algoritmo seleccionó
`r length(nombres_clave1)` para definir los clústeres:

```{r}
nombres_clave1 %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Taxon = 1) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Bacterias Discriminantes**"),
    subtitle = "Características seleccionadas por Sparse Hierarchical Clustering (Stool-I)"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(style = "italic"),
    locations = cells_body(columns = Taxon)
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = md("*Nota:* Selección generada bajo penalización L1.")
  )
```

## 5.3 Dirichlet Multinomial Mixtures (DMM)

Se ajustaron modelos DMM evaluando de 1 a 5 posibles agrupaciones para
determinar la existencia de estructuras comunitarias latentes:

```{r dmm, include=FALSE}
ps_stool_I = subset_samples(ps_stool, samp_n == "I")
ps_stool_I = prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_stool_I) > 0, ps_stool_I)
ps_stool_I_genus = tax_glom(ps_stool_I, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)

taxa_info = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_stool_I_genus))
nombres_genero = taxa_info$Genus
nombres_genero[is.na(nombres_genero)] = "unclassified"
taxa_names(ps_stool_I_genus) = make.unique(as.character(nombres_genero))

matriz_conteos = as(otu_table(ps_stool_I_genus), "matrix")
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_stool_I_genus)) matriz_conteos = t(matriz_conteos)

muestras_vacias = rowSums(matriz_conteos) == 0
if (any(muestras_vacias)) {
  matriz_conteos = matriz_conteos[!muestras_vacias, ]
}

set.seed(1234)
k_maximo = 5
fit_dmm = lapply(1:k_maximo, function(k) dmn(count = matriz_conteos, k = k))

lplc = sapply(fit_dmm, laplace)
mejor_k = which.min(lplc)
mejor_modelo = fit_dmm[[mejor_k]]
```

El análisis del ajuste probabilístico mediante la aproximación de
Laplace reveló una minimización absoluta del error en $k = $`r mejor_k`:

**Figura 9:** *Selección del modelo óptimo (DMM), Heces en T1*

```{r}
plot(1:k_maximo, lplc, type = "b", pch = 19, col = "blue",
     xlab = "Número de Clústeres (k)", ylab = "Valor de Laplace",
     main = "Selección del Modelo Óptimo (DMM), Heces en T1")
abline(v = mejor_k, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

# 6. Maaslin2

## 6.1 Pregunta de investigación

¿Cómo cambia el microbioma según el tipo de parto, teniendo en cuenta
que cada bebé es un individuo único que aporta varias muestras?

- **Efectos fijos:** `b_type` (tipo de parto)
- **Efectos aleatorios:** `p_code` (individuo)
- **Referencia:** Vaginal
- **Normalización:** TSS + LOG

> Esto es un análisis de asociación, no implica causalidad.

## 6.2 Generación de datos y ajuste de Maaslin2

```{r maaslin_load, include=FALSE}
build_maaslin_data = function(physeq_obj, metadata) {
  # 1. Agrupar a nivel de género
  asv_df_p = tax_glom(physeq_obj, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = FALSE)
  asv_df_prev = as.data.frame(otu_table(asv_df_p))
  taxa_info = as.data.frame(tax_table(asv_df_p))

  taxa_genus = taxa_info$Genus
  taxa_genus[is.na(taxa_genus)] = "unclassified"

  if (length(rownames(asv_df_prev)) != length(taxa_info$Genus)) {
    stop("El número de filas NO coinciden, revisa el estado de los datos")
  }
  row.names(asv_df_prev) = make.unique(as.character(taxa_genus))
  asv_df_prev = as.data.frame(t(asv_df_prev))

  abundancia_df = asv_df_prev %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "id_muestra") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -id_muestra, names_to = "Taxon", values_to = "Abundancia") %>%
    mutate(Taxon = gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", Taxon)) %>%
    group_by(id_muestra, Taxon) %>%
    summarise(Abundancia = sum(Abundancia), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Taxon, values_from = Abundancia) %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "id_muestra") %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

  muestras_comunes = intersect(rownames(abundancia_df), rownames(metadata))
  abundancia_df = abundancia_df[muestras_comunes, ]
  metadata_f = metadata[muestras_comunes, ]

  abundancia_df = abundancia_df %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "id") %>%
    mutate(type = case_when(
      startsWith(id, "ML") ~ "Milk",
      startsWith(id, "MH") ~ "Stool"
    ))

  # 5. Separar en leches y heces
  maas_leches = abundancia_df %>%
    filter(type == "Milk") %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "id") %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

  maas_heces = abundancia_df %>%
    filter(type == "Stool") %>%
    column_to_rownames(var = "id") %>%
    dplyr::select(where(is.numeric))

  list(maas_leches = maas_leches, maas_heces = maas_heces, metadata = metadata_f)
}

run_maaslin = function(input_data, metadata, output_dir) {
  metadata = metadata[rownames(metadata) %in% rownames(input_data), ]
  metadata = metadata %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("p_code", "b_type")))

  Maaslin2::Maaslin2(
    input_data = input_data,
    input_metadata = metadata,
    output = output_dir,

    # Efectos fijos: tipo de parto
    fixed_effects = c("b_type"),

    # Efectos aleatorios: ID de la persona
    random_effects = c("p_code"),

    # Parto vaginal como referencia
    reference = c("b_type,Vaginal"),

    min_abundance = 0.0001,
    min_prevalence = 0.1,

    normalization = "TSS", # Total Sum Scaling
    transform = "LOG",     # Log transform
    standardize = FALSE    # Mantener interpretabilidad de los coeficientes
  )
}

# Generar los datos y correr Maaslin2 para ambos tipos de muestra
maas_data = build_maaslin_data(HMilkclean_filtered, metadata)
maas_leches = maas_data$maas_leches
maas_heces  = maas_data$maas_heces

cat("Maaslin - Leches:", dim(maas_leches), "\n")
cat("Maaslin - Heces: ", dim(maas_heces), "\n")

run_maaslin(maas_heces,  maas_data$metadata, paste0(gen_path, "/Data/processed/resultados_maaslin_heces"))
run_maaslin(maas_leches, maas_data$metadata, paste0(gen_path, "/Data/processed/resultados_maaslin_leches"))

# Cargar los resultados generados
resultados_heces  = read.delim(paste0(gen_path, "/Data/processed/resultados_maaslin_heces/all_results.tsv"))
resultados_leches = read.delim(paste0(gen_path, "/Data/processed/resultados_maaslin_leches/all_results.tsv"))
```


# 7. PERMANOVA

## 7.1 Tipo de parto (Heces T1)

Se evalúa si el tipo de parto explica la variación en la composición
microbiana (distancia Bray-Curtis):

```{r permanova, include=FALSE}
subset_test_stool = cluster_by_time_type[["Stool_I"]]

m1 = metadata %>%
  filter(sam_ %in% subset_test_stool$sam_id)

subset_test_stool$type_t = m1$b_type

subset_test_stool2 = subset_test_stool %>% select_if(is.numeric)
subset_test_stool2 = subset_test_stool2[, colSums(subset_test_stool2) > 0]

bray_dist_matrix = vegdist(subset_test_stool2, method = "bray")

set.seed(123)
permanova_res = adonis2(bray_dist_matrix ~ type_t,
                         data = subset_test_stool,
                         permutations = 999)
```

```{r}
permanova_res
```

No se logra obtener suficiente evidencia de que el tipo de parto
explique la variación en la composición microbiana de heces en el
tiempo I.

# 8. UMAP Supervisado

Se introduce la etiqueta temporal como variable objetivo para evaluar
si el algoritmo puede separar los tiempos de muestreo:

```{r umap_supervised, include=FALSE}
# Trayectorias
datos_trayectoriaMilk = asv_df_genus %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Milk") %>%
  mutate(paciente_id = sub("-[^-]+$", "", sam_id)) %>%
  arrange(paciente_id, time)

metadatosMilk = datos_trayectoriaMilk %>%
  select(sam_id, sample_type, time, paciente_id)

asv_numeric_traj1 = datos_trayectoriaMilk %>%
  select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time, -paciente_id)
asv_numeric_traj1[] = lapply(asv_numeric_traj1, as.numeric)
filas_validas = rowSums(asv_numeric_traj1) > 0
asv_numeric_traj1 = asv_numeric_traj1[filas_validas, ]
asv_numeric_traj1 = asv_numeric_traj1[, colSums(asv_numeric_traj1) > 0]
metadatosMilk = metadatosMilk[filas_validas, ]

datos_trayectoriaStool = asv_df_genus %>%
  filter(sample_type == "Stool") %>%
  mutate(paciente_id = sub("-[^-]+$", "", sam_id)) %>%
  arrange(paciente_id, time)

metadatosStool = datos_trayectoriaStool %>%
  select(sam_id, sample_type, time, paciente_id)

asv_numeric_traj2 = datos_trayectoriaStool %>%
  select(-sam_id, -sample_type, -time, -paciente_id)
asv_numeric_traj2[] = lapply(asv_numeric_traj2, as.numeric)
filas_validas = rowSums(asv_numeric_traj2) > 0
asv_numeric_traj2 = asv_numeric_traj2[filas_validas, ]
asv_numeric_traj2 = asv_numeric_traj2[, colSums(asv_numeric_traj2) > 0]
metadatosStool = metadatosStool[filas_validas, ]

# UMAP supervisado - Leches
variable_y = metadatosMilk$time
set.seed(1234)
umap_resL = vegdist(asv_numeric_traj1, method = "bray")
umap_sup_milk = uwot::umap(
  X = umap_resL, y = variable_y,
  target_weight = 0.3, n_neighbors = 10, min_dist = 0.1
)
umap_coords_sup = as.data.frame(umap_sup_milk)
colnames(umap_coords_sup) = c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
plot_data_sup_milk = bind_cols(metadatosMilk, umap_coords_sup)

# UMAP supervisado - Heces
variable_y = metadatosStool$time
set.seed(1234)
umap_res2 = vegdist(asv_numeric_traj2, method = "bray")
umap_sup_stool = uwot::umap(
  X = umap_res2, y = variable_y,
  target_weight = 0.3, n_neighbors = 5, min_dist = 0.1
)
umap_coords_sup = as.data.frame(umap_sup_stool)
colnames(umap_coords_sup) = c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
plot_data_sup_stool = bind_cols(metadatosStool, umap_coords_sup)
```

**Figura 12:** *UMAP supervisado: Trayectoria temporal en leches*

```{r}
ggplot(plot_data_sup_milk, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = paciente_id),
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
            color = "gray60", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = time), shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("I" = "#E69F00", "II" = "#56B4E9", "III" = "#009E73")) +
  labs(
    title = "Trayectoria Temporal del Microbioma en Leches (UMAP Supervisado)",
    subtitle = "Espacio Topológico No Lineal",
    x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", fill = "Tiempo"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), legend.position = "right")
```

**Figura 13:** *UMAP supervisado: Trayectoria temporal en heces*

```{r}
ggplot(plot_data_sup_stool, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_path(aes(group = paciente_id),
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm"), type = "closed"),
            color = "gray60", alpha = 0.7, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = time), shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("I" = "#E69F00", "II" = "#56B4E9", "III" = "#009E73")) +
  labs(
    title = "Trayectoria Temporal del Microbioma en Heces (UMAP Supervisado)",
    subtitle = "Espacio Topológico No Lineal",
    x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", fill = "Tiempo"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14), legend.position = "right")
```

Se observa tendencia de agrupamiento, pero con cautela: hay valores
atípicos que influyen en la estructura. Los datos indican que dentro de
las bacterias sí hay diferencias temporales, pero UMAP realiza
transformaciones no lineales que dificultan determinar cuáles son las
evidencias que realmente discriminan el tiempo.
